apps.name: mataa_app
iosLinuxLimits: the app builds its iOS plugins with CocoaPods, and Linux iOS builds need Swift Package Manager (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager)

flavors.name: dev
iosLinuxLimits: its configuration Release-dev reads the Info.plist Runner/Info-Dev.plist, and Linux iOS builds read Runner/Info.plist only (omarchy-apple-dev: an Info.plist per configuration)

findings.message: Flavor prod is com.mataaa on Android and com.sixdtec.mata on iOS.
findings.fix: Ignore this if the apps are meant to have different ids; otherwise make them agree.

findings.message: ios/Runner/Info-Dev.plist hard-codes its version, so flutter build --build-name and --build-number do not reach iOS.
findings.fix: Use $(FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME) and $(FLUTTER_BUILD_NUMBER) in the plist, or let XPath write the version into it: the plist is listed in the version files of its flavors.

findings.message: lib/main_preview.dart has no flavor of that name in Gradle, flutter_flavorizr or Xcode, so it is not treated as a flavor.
findings.fix: Ignore this if it is a special build of another flavor; otherwise add the flavor to the Android and iOS projects.

findings.message: Needs a Mac for iOS: Linux runners cannot build it because the app has the app extension NotificationServiceExtension, which Linux iOS builds do not support yet (omarchy-apple-dev: app extensions); the app builds its iOS plugins with CocoaPods, and Linux iOS builds need Swift Package Manager (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager).
findings.fix: Nothing to do to build on a Mac. To build on Linux (ADR 0014), lift each reason; until then its iOS jobs wait for a Mac (ios-sign).
